questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I am training a new batch of officers now.

options.text: A new batch of officers are trained now.
A new batch of officers were being trained by me now.
A new batch of officers are training me now.
A new batch of officers is being trained by me.

questions.solution:
The solution is A new batch of officers is being trained by me.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that expresses the " *I am training a new batch of officers now.*" in passive voice is 
 
• Passive voice - If the subject is having the action done to it, then the verb is called *passive voice*.
 
• ***Active voice : **I am training a new batch of officers now.*
 
• ***Passive voice : **A new batch of officers is being trained by me.*
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is a correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about voices :
 
 
• Passive voice - If the subject is having the action done to it, then the verb is called *passive voice*.
 
• Active voice - If the subject is performing the action, then the verb is called *active voice.*
 
 
• *​**For example: Active voice - Aditi cut a tree. Passive voice - A tree was cut by aditi.*

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I need to evaluate all the options available by the end of this month.

options.text: All the options available will be needed to evaluate by the end of this month.
I needed to evaluate all the options by the end of this month.
All the options will be needing evaluation with the end of this month.
All the options available need to be evaluated by me by the end of this month.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**All the options available need to be evaluated by me by the end of this month**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lets's look into the sentence "**I need to evaluate all the options available by the end of this month**".
 
• Here, "**by the end of the month**" is the **adjunct**. Let us keep it aside for some time.
 
• The **remaining part** of the sentence is "**I need to evaluate all the options available**".
 
• This is in the format "**Subject - Predicate - Object**".
 
• In order to change it to the **passive** form, we need to interchange it as "**Object - Predicate - Subject**",
 
• Therefore, the **passive** form of "**I need to evaluate all the options available**" is "**All the options available need to be evaluated by me**".
 
• If we add the **adjunct** with this sentence, the appropriate answer is "**All the options available need to be evaluated by me by the end of this month**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see the basic difference between **active and passive voice.**

 
 

 **Active Voice**
 **Passive Voice**
 
 

 Talks about **what the person or thing did**.
 Talks about **what happened to someone or something**.
 
 

 The **subject is the doer **of the action and the** object is the sufferer** of the action. 
 The **subject** is being **acted upon**.
 
 

 **Example:** *Jeff speaks English.*
 **Example:** *English is spoken by Jeff. *

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. People post images of their cuisine, daily cosmetic routines, shopping videos, and dance videos.

B. Uploading photos to social networking sites has grown popular in today's society.

C. Because of the rising influence of social media on people, they want to constantly appear their best.

D. Therefore people have become more image sensors and begun to prioritise personal care.
